_why_a_sidecar: gan_points.json is a bare JSON list and cannot carry these fields itself; the reproducibility notebook reads it with json.loads(...) as a list, so wrapping it in an object would break that consumer. score_anchors.load_anchor() merges this file.

source.citation: Gan et al. 2021, universal keyhole scaling, dataset SD1

depth_measurement: in-situ synchrotron X-ray imaging of the vapour depression. NOT a metallographic fusion depth -- fusion is always the larger, and comparing our fusion depth against these values inflates the apparent gap.
warning_eta_is_not_measured: the `eta` column is a ray-tracing MODEL OUTPUT, not a measurement. Never cite it as experimental absorptance; doing so was retracted on 2026-07-29.
